meta.name: Mismatch
meta.description: Mishka is terrified of her husband Abir's fantasies. Her boss Aditi intimidates her husband Anirban. The two mismatched couples begin a wild journey!

videos.title: Toka Tok Toka Tok
videos.overview: Ayan and Diana make an odd couple, much to the latter’s displeasure. On the contrary, Subhro is not satisfied with Urmi. How will the couple change situations?

videos.title: Tumi Ki Amar Choto Pisi?
videos.overview: Subhro is elated to take Urmi for a trip, that she agrees to with much timidity for reasons known to her. Can Diana convince Ayan for a mystery tour as planned?

videos.title: I Love To Push
videos.overview: Upon reaching the destination, Ayan gets the shock of his life after finding the reason for the trip is a quick episode of couple swapping! Will he go for it?

videos.title: Parallel Universe
videos.overview: The spree of adventure for Diana and her partner gets a jerk, when some uncalled situations arise, and arrive in the same hotel where the couples are staying!

videos.title: Meye Dakat!!
videos.overview: Things turn worse for Ayan and Urmi, while Diana and Subhro feel their’s is a perfect match. Are they deciding to call it quits with their respective partners?

videos.title: What The Fcuk!
videos.overview: It’s time for the couples to face the blows from their better halves, not for better but for worse!

videos.title: I am Cuckold
videos.overview: Mishka is trying to live up to her strict boss Aditi’s expectations. Meanwhile, both are struggling to fix their marriages with Abir and Anirban, respectively.

videos.title: Nemey Jachhey Keno
videos.overview: A super angry Aditi's husband is having fun with another woman. Abir tries to convince Mishka to be the hotwife to the bull of his choice.

videos.title: Fact or Fantasy
videos.overview: Anirban and Mishka end up in a police station while enjoying themselves behind Abir’s back. Abir's reaction does not match his liberal ways.

videos.title: Karma is a B**ch
videos.overview: Abir and Aditi start to get closer, making Mishka’s life miserable. On the other hand, Anirban realises his true feelings for Mishka.

videos.title: Me and My Girlfriends
videos.overview: Mishka and Aditi confront Abir and Anirban for all the mess in their lives. Will the two mismatched couples finally find what they want?

videos.title: Bedtime Story
videos.overview: RK regrets Nibedita's inability to moan, and Imtiaj his nude painter wife. How will they spice up their sex life?

videos.title: Double Trouble
videos.overview: The boring sex life pushes the couples to the verge of separation. But there's a solution to the rescue.

videos.title: Secrets of Batsayana
videos.overview: Milan Baba provides a one stop solution for a spiced up sex life. But what's his secret?

videos.title: Adalam-Badalam
videos.overview: Milan Baba's workshop revives Nibedita's ability to mourn with Adalam-Badalam.

videos.title: Anti - Climax
videos.overview: Behind the closed doors of the Ashrama, a larger evil lurks. Can the couples solve the mystery?
